doc.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000

title: Business partner and his job as USC jazz chair
summary: A partner handles contracts and copying; Berg also chairs jazz studies at USC's Thornton School.

venues.name: Thornton School of Music, University of Southern California

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Do you do all your own business as far as contracts and all that kind of thing?

Yeah I have a partner and he kind of manages the business of the office so I’m not having to fill out too many contracts or copy any parts or hire players. So it works out well because he’s a great musician too but he’s also willing to do that stuff.
I get tired thinking about your schedule I guess.

Yeah I mean I am the Chair of Jazz Music in the Thornton School at University of Southern California and that’s kind of a full time job too. But that’s a great job. I love it. We have wonderful students and incredible faculty. It’s a real Who’s Who.
